# opamr

**opamr** retrieves English primary-care antibiotic prescribing data
from [OpenPrescribing](https://openprescribing.net/api/), translates
between the vocabularies used in prescribing and resistance data (BNF
codes, ATC codes, [`AMR`](https://amr-for-r.org/) package codes and drug
names), and draws publication-quality `ggplot2` figures.

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Crosswalk** | [`ab_to_bnf()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/ab_to_bnf.md), [`bnf_to_ab()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_to_ab.md), [`atc_to_bnf()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/atc_to_bnf.md), [`bnf_to_atc()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/atc_to_bnf.md), [`op_antibiotics()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_antibiotics.md), [`bnf_class()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_level.md). Uses a bundled table of 121 BNF chemicals and works offline. |
| **Data** | [`op_spending()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_spending.md) and [`op_spending_ab()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_spending_ab.md) (monthly items, quantity and cost nationally or by Sub-ICB Location, ICB, PCN or practice); [`op_org_details()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_org_details.md), [`op_rate()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_rate.md) and [`op_antibiotic_use()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_antibiotic_use.md) (list-size and STAR-PU rates); [`op_bnf_search()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_bnf_search.md) and [`op_org_search()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_org_search.md) |
| **Figures** | [`op_plot_trend()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_trend.md), [`op_plot_seasonal()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_seasonal.md), [`op_plot_distribution()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_distribution.md), [`op_plot_heatmap()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_heatmap.md), [`theme_op()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/theme_op.md), [`op_save()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_save.md) |

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("vargasrichards/opamr")
```

`AMR` is optional. It lets free-text names, brand names and misspellings
be resolved.

## Example

``` r

library(opamr)

# antimicrobial names, AMR codes and ATC codes -> BNF chemical codes
ab_to_bnf(c("co-amoxiclav", "NIT", "J01AA02"), use_amr = FALSE)[, c("input", "ab", "atc", "bnf_chemical_code")]
#>          input  ab     atc bnf_chemical_code
#> 1 co-amoxiclav AMC J01CR02         0501013K0
#> 2          NIT NIT J01XE01         0501130R0
#> 3      J01AA02 DOX J01AA02         0501030I0
#> 4      J01AA02 DOX J01AA02         0501030Z0

# a whole class by ATC prefix
ab_to_bnf("J01MA", output = "codes")
#> [1] "0501120L0" "0501120P0" "0501120Q0" "0501120X0" "0501120Y0"

# any BNF code (here a 15-character presentation) -> antimicrobial
bnf_to_ab("0501013B0AAAAAA")[, c("input", "ab", "ab_name", "atc")]
#>             input  ab     ab_name     atc
#> 1 0501013B0AAAAAA AMX Amoxicillin J01CA04
```

Download prescribing (needs network access):

``` r

use  <- op_spending_ab(c("amoxicillin", "nitrofurantoin", "doxycycline"))               # England, monthly
rate <- op_antibiotic_use("amoxicillin", org_type = "sicbl",
                          denominator = "star_pu.oral_antibacterial_items")              # every Sub-ICB Location
```

Figures from the bundled national example data:

``` r

top <- op_example[op_example$ab_name %in% c("Amoxicillin", "Doxycycline", "Nitrofurantoin",
                                            "Flucloxacillin", "Trimethoprim"), ]
op_plot_trend(top, y = "items", events = data.frame(date = "2022-12-01", label = "Strep A surge"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-trend-1.png)

``` r

op_plot_seasonal(top[top$ab %in% c("AMX", "NIT"), ], y = "items", years = 2022:2026)
```

![](reference/figures/README-seasonal-1.png)

``` r

p <- op_plot_trend(top, y = "items")
op_save(p, "figure1.pdf", width = "single")   # 85 mm; "onehalf" 120 mm; "double" 178 mm
```

## Data and limitations

- **What the data cover.** Prescription items dispensed in the community
  on prescriptions issued in English primary care. Data are monthly,
  with a lag of about two months. Hospital inpatient use is not
  included. There are no indications, doses or patient identifiers.
- **Licence and citation.** The data are published by the NHS Business
  Services Authority under the Open Government Licence v3.0, and served
  by OpenPrescribing (Bennett Institute for Applied Data Science,
  University of Oxford). Cite both.
- **How `antibiotic_crosswalk` was built.** BNF chemical names from the
  English Prescribing Dataset were matched to `AMR` codes with
  [`AMR::as.ab()`](https://amr-for-r.org/reference/as.ab.html). Matches
  were filtered to reject false positives, and a reviewed override table
  was applied. Chemicals not dispensed in the community during the build
  months are absent. Antivirals and antiparasitics are out of scope.
  `data-raw/build_crosswalk.R` rebuilds the table.
- **Where `op_example` comes from.** National monthly totals for BNF
  section 5.1, aggregated from the English Prescribing Dataset
  (`data-raw/build_example.R`). They were not downloaded through the
  API.
- **Testing of the API functions.** They are tested against mocked
  responses with the structure used in the OpenPrescribing server
  source. Live-API tests exist but are off by default: set
  `OPAMR_LIVE_TESTS=true` to run them. OpenPrescribing sits behind bot
  protection, which rejects some automated clients. If you see an “HTML
  page” error, see
  [`?op_check_api`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_check_api.md).

# Package index

## Crosswalk

Convert between antimicrobial names, AMR codes, ATC codes and BNF codes
(offline).

- [`ab_to_bnf()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/ab_to_bnf.md)
  : Convert antimicrobial names, AMR codes or ATC codes to BNF codes
- [`bnf_to_ab()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_to_ab.md)
  : Convert BNF codes to AMR package antimicrobial codes
- [`atc_to_bnf()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/atc_to_bnf.md)
  [`bnf_to_atc()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/atc_to_bnf.md)
  : Convert between ATC codes and BNF chemical codes
- [`op_antibiotics()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_antibiotics.md)
  : List the antimicrobials in the crosswalk
- [`bnf_level()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_level.md)
  [`bnf_parent()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_level.md)
  [`bnf_class()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/bnf_level.md)
  : Describe the structure of BNF codes

## Prescribing data

Monthly items, quantity and cost from the OpenPrescribing API.

- [`op_spending()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_spending.md)
  : Prescribing items, quantity and cost from OpenPrescribing
- [`op_spending_ab()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_spending_ab.md)
  : Prescribing data by antimicrobial name
- [`op_antibiotic_use()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_antibiotic_use.md)
  : Antimicrobial use as a rate, in one call

## Denominators and rates

- [`op_org_details()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_org_details.md)
  : Practice list size and STAR-PU by organisation
- [`op_rate()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_rate.md)
  : Convert counts to rates per population or weighted-population
  denominator

## Lookups and API utilities

- [`op_bnf_search()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_bnf_search.md)
  : Search BNF codes
- [`op_org_search()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_org_search.md)
  : Search organisation codes
- [`op_check_api()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_check_api.md)
  : Check that the OpenPrescribing API is reachable
- [`op_cache_clear()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_cache_clear.md)
  : Clear the opamr response cache

## Figures

Publication-quality ggplot2 figures with a colour-blind safe palette and
direct labels.

- [`op_plot_trend()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_trend.md)
  : Publication-quality prescribing time series
- [`op_plot_seasonal()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_seasonal.md)
  : Seasonal profile: one line per year
- [`op_plot_distribution()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_distribution.md)
  : Distribution of prescribing across organisations over time
- [`op_plot_heatmap()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_plot_heatmap.md)
  : Heatmap of drugs (or organisations) by month
- [`op_save()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_save.md)
  : Save a figure at journal size
- [`theme_op()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/theme_op.md)
  : A clean, journal-ready ggplot2 theme
- [`scale_colour_op()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/scale_colour_op.md)
  [`scale_fill_op()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/scale_colour_op.md)
  : Colour-blind safe discrete ggplot2 scales
- [`op_palette()`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_palette.md)
  : Colour-blind safe palette

## Data

- [`antibiotic_crosswalk`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/antibiotic_crosswalk.md)
  : Antimicrobial crosswalk: BNF chemical substances and AMR package
  antimicrobials
- [`op_example`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/op_example.md)
  : Example national antibacterial prescribing, November 2020 to June
  2026

## Package

- [`opamr`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/opamr-package.md)
  [`opamr-package`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/opamr/reference/opamr-package.md)
  : opamr: antibiotic prescribing data from OpenPrescribing, linked to
  the AMR package
